description: This file defines a utility function `apiGet` for performing HTTP GET requests, handling URL construction, authorization headers, and response parsing. It facilitates making authenticated API calls with special handling for JSON and text responses, and appends organization ID parameters where needed.

methods.name: isAbsoluteUrl(url)
methods.description: Checks if the given URL is an absolute URL starting with 'http://' or 'https://'.

methods.name: joinUrl(base, path)
methods.description: Joins a base URL and a path, ensuring proper slashes.

methods.name: apiGet(url, options = {})
methods.description: Performs a GET request to the specified URL, adding authorization headers and organization ID query parameter if applicable.
